statement: The CISA KEV catalog adds an entry for the Xen Orchestra authentication bypass vulnerability with a date-added value between 2026-11-12 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog JSON contains an entry whose vendor or product field names Xen Orchestra or Vates with dateAdded between 2026-11-12 and 2026-11-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry naming Xen Orchestra or Vates carries a dateAdded value inside the window.
